items.name: consent-banner
items.description: A GDPR-compliant cookie consent banner with equally prominent Accept All and Reject All buttons, plus an optional Preferences button. Shows a floating Cookie Settings button after consent for withdrawing or changing preferences.

items.name: consent-panel
items.description: A preferences modal panel with per-category toggles, service sub-toggles and a cookie details table.

items.name: consent-table
items.description: A read-only cookie details table for displaying cookie definitions.

items.name: consent-toggle
items.description: An accessible labelled toggle switch for consent categories and services, with optional description text.
